content.text:
Read-only findings:

- Public pages share `AppShell.svelte`, which owns header, skip link and footer. Footer’s Methodology link is independent of the landing page’s Methodology button; replace only footer href/text/current state with About.
- Catch-all `routes/[...path]/+page.server.ts` maps `/methodology` to typed `PageModel`; `App.svelte` selects its component and `lib/page.ts` owns title, description and skip-link target.
- Markdown already compiles through mdsvex in `vite.config.ts`. `MethodologyPage.svelte` imports `methodology.md` as a component and wraps it in accessible main/article elements.
- `about.md` exists but is unused. It has copied/broken IDs: heading `methodology-heading`; sections labelled `who`/`feedback` while headings use `interpretation`/`sources`. Social links are empty and blog has no link. These need correction or supplied destinations.
- Shared `Field` supports only text/search/date; no textarea exists. A contact form needing email and multiline feedback requires extending the design system (email type plus reusable textarea), barrel export, README, gallery and behavior tests. `Button` and `Notice` already cover submission and status presentation.
- No email delivery adapter, mail package or mail configuration exists. Searched source/dependencies and inspected only environment variable **names**: none configure email. SMTP/provider/destination decisions cannot be inferred.

Minimal integration: create dedicated `/about/+page.server.ts` and `+page.svelte` for a SvelteKit form action, with an `AboutPage.svelte` rendering the markdown and form inside `AppShell`. This follows the existing dedicated rankings/updates route pattern and avoids putting About-specific actions into the catch-all. Alternatively extend `PageModel`/`App` for display, but a form action still needs deliberate route ownership.

Verification: extend `landing.spec.ts` for footer About, SSR, skip target and no Rust API requests; add About form cases for invalid input, delivery failure, success and no-JavaScript submission. Tests use `tests/backend.ts`, which starts an isolated Node app plus mock Rust server; a mail adapter mock would require an equivalent injected test endpoint. Run check/build and affected Playwright tests; capture desktop screenshots for PR attachments.
